blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Online Research and Digital Literacy) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define online research and state its goal. Explain why online research is important and how a researcher makes sure that online information is accurate. (8 marks)
(Online research ki definition aur maqsad likhein. Wazahat karein ke online research kyun aham hai aur researcher kaise yaqeeni banata hai ke online maloomat durust hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: online research internet par kisi khaas mauzu ki maloomat dhoondne ka amal hai, articles, reports ya videos jaise online zariyon se.
Maqsad: durust, qabil-e-aitbaar aur taaza maloomat jama karna jo mauzu samajhne ya masla hal karne mein madad de.

Ahmiyat:
1. Is se bohat si maloomat jaldi aur aasani se milti hai; jab taqreeban har cheez internet se juri hai to online maloomat dhoondna aur istemal karna qeemti hunar hai.
2. Yeh students ko homework, professionals ko apne shobe mein update rehne aur sab ko soch samajh kar faislay karne mein madad deti hai.

Durusti yaqeeni banana:
1. Internet ki saari maloomat durust nahin; kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah kun details deti hain, is liye maloomat qabil-e-aitbaar zariyon se leni chahiye.
2. Qabil-e-aitbaar zariye: official government websites, taleemi idare aur mashhoor akhbaraat.
3. Kai zariyon ki maloomat ka muqabla kar ke nataij ki durusti pakki hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: When conducting online research, it is essential to check if the information comes from a reliable source.

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain fact-checking research and health research. How does each use reliable sources? Why is each needed? (8 marks)
(Fact-checking research aur health research samjhayein. Har aik qabil-e-aitbaar zariyon ko kaise istemal karti hai? Har aik kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Fact-checking research: yeh tasdeeq karne ke liye hai ke maloomat durust hai ya nahin.
Zariyon ka istemal: kai qabil-e-aitbaar zariye dekh kar haqaiq ki durusti pakki ki jati hai.
Zaroorat: internet ki saari maloomat durust nahin aur kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah kun details deti hain; fact-checking yaqeeni banati hai ke jama kiye haqaiq durust aur mufeed hon.

2. Health research: yeh sehat ke masail, ilaaj ya healthcare services ki maloomat dhoondti hai.
Zariyon ka istemal: qabil-e-aitbaar health websites aur medical journals.
Zaroorat: yeh logon ko alamaat, ilaaj aur sehatmand rehne ke tareeqe batati hai; sirf qabil-e-aitbaar health zariye istemal karne se log ghalat maloomat se bachte hain.

book_ref.quote: This type is used to verify if the information is accurate.

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the digital literacy components evaluating sources and online safety and privacy, with an example of each. Why is each needed? (8 marks)
(Digital literacy ke hisse evaluating sources aur online safety and privacy aik aik misal ke saath samjhayein. Har aik kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Evaluating sources: dekhna ke online mili maloomat qabil-e-aitbaar hai, yeh dekh kar ke content kis ne banaya aur zariya bharose ka hai ya nahin.
Misal: Lahore ki teacher ko aik website milti hai jo taaza taleemi tareeqon ka daawa karti hai; woh istemal se pehle dekhti hai ke yeh kisi taleemi ya mo'tabar idare ki hai.
Zaroorat: internet ki har maloomat durust nahin, is liye istemal se pehle zariye ki jaanch zaroori hai.

2. Online safety and privacy: zaati maloomat ki hifazat aur internet par mehfooz rehna, jis mein mazboot passwords aur mumkina online khatraat ki pehchan shamil hai.
Misal: Islamabad ka shakhs social media par privacy settings lagata hai taake tay kare ke zaati maloomat kaun dekhe, aur mashkook links par click nahin karta.
Zaroorat: digital platforms istemal karte waqt zaati maloomat aur online security ki hifazat hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Evaluating sources involves checking if the information you find online is reliable.

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the digital literacy components using technology, searching for information and creating digital content, with the chapter's example for each. (8 marks)
(Digital literacy ke hisse using technology, searching for information aur creating digital content, har aik ki chapter wali misal ke saath, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Using technology: computers, tablets aur smartphones jaise devices chalana, jis mein programs kholna, applications istemal karna aur websites par jana shamil hai.
Misal: student computer aur word processing software se school report type aur format karta hai.

2. Searching for information: internet par data dhoondne ke liye search engines istemal karna, munasib keywords likh kar aur nataij ko behtar kar ke mufeed maloomat talash karna.
Misal: Punjab ka kisan nayi aabpashi ke tareeqe seekhne ke liye Google par "modern irrigation techniques for wheat" search karta hai.

3. Creating digital content: apna mawad banana, jaise articles likhna, presentations banana ya photos edit karna; is ke liye mukhtalif software aur tools ka ilm chahiye.
Misal: Karachi ka student class project ki PowerPoint presentation mein presentation software se slides, text aur images dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Searching for information means using search engines to find data on the internet.

blocks.prompt:
5 What are advanced information retrieval techniques? Explain the effective use of search engines, choosing effective keywords and advanced search features with examples. (8 marks)
(Advanced information retrieval techniques kya hain? Search engines ka behtar istemal, asar-daar keywords ka intikhab aur advanced search features misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Advanced information retrieval techniques search engines se behtar nataij lene aur theek wohi maloomat dhoondne mein madad deti hain jo chahiye.

1. Search engines ka behtar istemal: Google jaise search engines taqatwar tools hain; query aisi likhein ke behtareen nataij milen.
Misal: sirf "recipes" ke bajaye "traditional pakistani recipes" likhne se zyada khaas nataij milte hain.

2. Asar-daar keywords: keywords woh alfaaz hain jo search engine mein likhe jate hain. Mauzu ke sab se aham alfaaz soch kar likhein taake munasib maloomat jaldi mile.
Misal: Punjab ka kisan sirf "farming" ke bajaye "organic farming" likhe to zyada munasib maloomat milti hai.

3. Advanced search features: bohat se search engines nataij ko date, location waghera se filter karte hain taake sab se munasib aur taaza maloomat mile.
Misal: student "Pakistan's education policy" ki taaza khabron ke liye nataij pichle saal tak filter karta hai.

(Boolean operators AND, OR aur NOT search behtar karne ki aik aur technique hain.)

book_ref.quote: Finding information online can be more effective if you use advanced techniques.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define Boolean operators. Explain AND, OR and NOT with examples, and write a search query with each for a research project on wheat crops. (8 marks)
(Boolean operators ki definition likhein. AND, OR aur NOT misalon ke saath samjhayein, aur gandum ki fasal ke research project ke liye har aik se aik search query likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Boolean operators khaas alfaaz hain jo search ko behtar (refine) karte hain: AND, OR aur NOT.

1. AND kai alfaaz shamil karta hai: nataij mein saare alfaaz hote hain.
Kitab ki misal: "agriculture AND irrigation" se dono alfaaz wale nataij.
Query: wheat AND irrigation

2. OR woh nataij deta hai jin mein dono mein se koi aik lafz ho.
Kitab ki misal: "Crops OR vegetables" se kisi bhi aik lafz wale nataij.
Query: wheat OR crops

3. NOT kuch alfaaz ko search se nikal deta hai.
Kitab ki misal: "Farming NOT pesticides" se farming ke woh nataij jin mein pesticides ka zikr na ho.
Query: wheat NOT pesticides

In operators se nataij mehdood ya wasee hote hain aur mufeed maloomat jaldi milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Boolean operators are special words that help you refine your search.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is meant by formulating research inquiries? Describe the steps of the chapter's activity for writing a research question and a hypothesis, and explain why a good research question matters. (8 marks)
(Formulating research inquiries se kya muraad hai? Chapter ki activity ke qadam bayan karein jin se research sawal aur hypothesis likha jata hai, aur batayein ke achha research sawal kyun aham hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Formulating research inquiries research ki rehnumai karne wale sawal banane ka amal hai. Yeh sawal batate hain ke aap kya seekhna aur kis ka jawab dhoondna chahte hain; achhi research ke liye wazeh aur asar-daar sawal zaroori hain.

Activity ke qadam:
1. Aisa mauzu chunein jis mein dilchaspi ho, maslan khurak ka students ki energy par asar.
2. Mauzu se mutaliq aik khaas research sawal likhein.
3. Sawal ki bunyad par aisa hypothesis (qiyas) banayein jo research se test ho sake.
4. Sawal aur hypothesis share karein aur bahas karein ke us ka jawab dene ke liye study kaise design ho.

Achha sawal kyun aham: achha research sawal kamyab research project ka pehla qadam hai. Soch samajh kar bana sawal poori study ki simt tay karta hai aur sahi jawab dhoondne par tawajjuh rakhta hai; sahi sawal aur soche samjhe andaze bamaani research projects design karne dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Objective: Help students practice formulating research questions and hypotheses.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define utilizing digital resources. Explain how online libraries and academic journals are used in research, with an example. (8 marks)
(Utilizing digital resources ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke research mein online libraries aur academic journals kaise istemal hote hain, misal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Utilizing digital resources yani internet par maujood tools aur maloomat, jaise articles, videos aur websites, ka apne kaam ya taleem ke liye achha istemal.

Online libraries aur research databases: digital daur mein bohat si libraries aur research databases online hain jo bohat se ilmi wasail tak rasai deti hain; yeh research projects ke liye qabil-e-aitbaar ilmi maloomat dhoondne mein madad deti hain.

Academic journals: mukhtalif shobon ke mahireen ke likhe articles ke majmue. Articles aam taur par peer-reviewed hote hain, yani shaya hone se pehle doosre mahireen check karte hain, is liye qabil-e-aitbaar hain. Students bohat se journals school libraries, university portals ya open-access websites se online parh sakte hain. Google Scholar ya ResearchGate jaisi websites kuch papers muft deti hain, aur Pakistan ki bohat si universities online libraries tak rasai deti hain.

Misal: maqami ecosystems par aaloodgi ke asraat ki research ke liye environmental science ki studies shaya karne wale academic journals dhoondein.

book_ref.quote: These digital tools can help you find reliable and scholarly information for your research projects.

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain effective navigation of online resources and the management of digital information during a research project. Describe how you would organize the articles you find. (8 marks)
(Research project ke dauran online resources mein behtar navigation aur digital maloomat ke intezam ki wazahat karein. Batayein ke aap mile hue articles kaise munazzam karenge.)
blocks.explanation:
Behtar navigation:
1. Mauzu se mutaliq khaas keywords se shuru karein.
2. Nataij mehdood karne ke liye advanced search options istemal karein.
3. Online libraries aur databases ke filters se date, author ya subject ke mutabiq search karein.

Digital maloomat ka intezam (mufeed resources milne ke baad bohat zaroori):
1. Articles ki digital copies save aur munazzam karein.
2. Ahem nukaat ke notes lein.
3. Aainda ke liye apne zariyon ka record rakhein.
4. Munazzam rehne ke liye digital folders, note-taking apps ya reference managers istemal karein; is se research aasan hoti hai.

Articles munazzam karna: computer par aik folder banayein, us mein articles ki PDFs save karein aur aik document mein un ke aham iqtibasat ya khayalat likhein. Achha intezam research ko efficient aur munazzam banata hai aur assignments aur projects ke nataij behtar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: When looking for information online, knowing how to search effectively is important.

blocks.prompt:
10 Define research ethics. Explain the five key principles of research ethics with an example where possible. (8 marks)
(Research ethics ki definition likhein. Research ethics ke paanch aham usool, jahan mumkin ho misal ke saath, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Research ethics woh usool aur hidayat hain jin par researchers amal karte hain taake kaam imandar, ba-izzat aur munsifana ho; yeh research ki saalmiyat qaim rakhte aur sab shamil logon ke haqooq aur behbood bachate hain.

1. Informed consent: shurakaa ko research ka maqsad batayein aur shamil karne se pehle ijazat lein. Misal: social media aur parhai ki aadaton ke survey mein zaati maloomat lene se pehle class fellows ki ijazat.
2. Confidentiality: shurakaa ki zaati maloomat aur jawabat raaz mein rakhein, ijazat ke baghair share na karein. Misal: survey ke jawabat raaz mein rakhna.
3. Integrity: imandar aur shaffaf rahein; data mein jaal-saazi, plagiarism ya nataij ko ghalat pesh na karein.
4. Respect for participants: sab shurakaa se izzat se pesh aayen aur yaqeeni banayein ke research se unhein koi nuqsan na ho.
5. Avoiding bias: research munsifana aur be-laag andaz mein karein aur nataij jama shuda saboot par rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Respect for Participants: Treat all participants with respect

blocks.prompt:
11 Define intellectual property. Explain why intellectual property is important, the role of IPO Pakistan, and how each kind of intellectual property can be protected. (8 marks)
(Intellectual property ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke intellectual property kyun aham hai, IPO Pakistan ka kya kirdar hai, aur har qism ki intellectual property kaise mehfooz ki ja sakti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Intellectual Property (IP) woh qanooni haqooq hain jo zehan ki takhleeqat ki hifazat karte hain, jaise ijadat, adabi aur fanni kaam, designs, symbols, naam aur karobari tasaveer. Yeh haqooq takhleeq karne walon ko apne kaam par ikhtiyar aur munafa dete hain taake unhein pehchan aur sila mile.

Ahmiyat: IP logon ko apne khayalat aur takhleeqat bachane mein madad deti hai; koi ijad ya fan-paara banaye to IP qawaneen yaqeeni banate hain ke munafa sirf use mile. Is se log naye khayalat aur ijadat par lage rehte hain kyun ke unhein sila milega. IP takhleeqi salahiyat aur taraqqi ko barhati hai.

IPO Pakistan: Pakistan ka Intellectual Property Organization mulk mein IP haqooq register aur mehfooz karta hai, taake takhleeq karne walon aur karobar ko ijadat ka sila mile.

Hifazat:
1. Patents: nayi ijad ke liye IPO Pakistan ke zariye patent ki darkhwast.
2. Trademarks: brand naam, logo ya slogan trademark ke taur par register karna.
3. Copyrights: takhleeqi kaam munasib idare ke paas register karwana.
4. Trade secrets: qeemti karobari maloomat raaz mein rakhna aur qanooni agreements istemal karna.

book_ref.quote: ensuring they are recognized and rewarded for their creativity and innovation

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between a trademark and an industrial design (4). Differentiate between a patent and a trade secret (4). Give an example from the chapter in each case. (8 marks)
(Trademark aur industrial design mein farq likhein (4). Patent aur trade secret mein farq likhein (4). Har soorat mein chapter se misal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Trademark aur industrial design (table): trademark batata hai ke product kis ka hai; industrial design product ki shakal-o-surat bachata hai.

Patent aur trade secret:
1. Patent ijad ke liye diya gaya khaas haq hai (aisa product ya process jo naya tareeqa ya naya technical hal de); trade secret raaz wali maloomat hai jo karobar ko muqable mein bartari deti hai.
2. Patent IPO Pakistan mein darkhwast se milta hai aur kuch saalon tak doosron ko ijazat ke baghair ijad banane, istemal karne ya bechne se rokta hai; trade secret awam ko nahin bataya jata aur confidentiality agreements aur doosre qanooni zariyon se mehfooz rehta hai.
3. Patent ki misal: Pakistani engineer ka zyada behtar solar panel. Trade secret ki misal: soft drink Pakola ki recipe jo company mein sirf chand log jante hain.

book_ref.quote: A trademark is a sign, logo, or name that distinguishes the goods or services of one company from those of others.

Shakal, tarteeb aur khoobsurti jo product ko munfarid aur dilkash banaye
Brand naam, logo ya slogan trademark ke taur par register kar ke mehfooz
